## Earnie 2.5.3

Official **PATCH** after **2.5.2**. Focus: Home Assistant add-on **Ingress** (embedded UI) ready for production use.

### Highlights

- **HA Ingress** — nginx on `:8501` re-attaches Supervisor `ingress_entry` and proxies to Streamlit on `:8502` with `baseUrlPath` (OPEN WEB UI without host `:8501` / IP lookup)
- **Ingress start fix** — add-on `run.sh` no longer aborts on a broken GNU `sed` escape when `ingress_entry` is present
- **Cold-start UX** — while Streamlit is still booting, nginx serves an auto-refreshing German page „Earnie startet noch“ as HTTP 200 (instead of a bare HA „502 Bad Gateway“); docs note ~20–40 s wait
- Community line that led here: `2.5.3-alpha.4` … `2.5.3-alpha.6`

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Legacy aliases: `ghcr.io/jochentcc/ernie-energy:2.5.3` / `:latest`

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

HA add-on: update to **2.5.3** from `https://github.com/JochenTCC/ha-addon-earnie` (Ingress / OPEN WEB UI).
